deadline.value: Each advertised project sets its own deadline; one listed project closes 31 October 2026.

gre_subject.value: The mathematics page does not mention a GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: Supervisors are assigned by the department, and an offer follows once a second supervisor is confirmed.
supervisor.quote: As soon as a second supervisor is confirmed, an offer will be sent to you through Pegasus, our online application system.

also.quote: Research supervisors are assigned to you by the Department of Mathematics & Statistics.

funding.value: Listed projects mix funded and unfunded places, and JARSS studentships are awarded by competition.
funding.quote: Funding: unfunded Graph representations | Funding: funded John Anderson Research Studentship Scheme (JARSS)

also.quote: The JARSS 2026/27 competition will open in November 2025 and students successful in this competition will commence studies in October 2026.

entry_route.value: The stated entry is an honours degree; the University's general page says research applicants normally have a Masters, so check with the department.
entry_route.quote: You require a first-class or upper second-class UK Honours degree, or overseas equivalent, in a mathematical sciences related subject.

also.quote: If you wish to apply for a research degree you'd normally have to have a Masters degree and some experience of research work.

ielts_min.value: The mathematics page asks for academic IELTS 6.5 with at least 5.5 in any section, or an equivalent.
ielts_min.quote: proof of English language proficiency (academic IELTS 6.5, with minimum 5.5 in any section, or equivalent) if English isn't your first language

notes: One department covers mathematics and statistics; Data Science & Statistics is a research group inside this PhD, not a separate programme.
